1946, March 12
The following is a faithful transcript of the typed original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH 225 Jerome Street Brooklyn, N. Y.
March 12th 1946
Dr. William Koch. Near Deaconess Hospital. East Jefferson Detroit, Michigan.
Dear Doctor Koch:
God bless you and yours. I do hope your are well and able to smile at at your international enemies - in so many cases perverters of truth and justice.
I received your kind favor through Sister Mary Clarissa of the Guardian Angels' Home. about two weeks ago; for which ... many thanks. I was hoping to get a chance to write you a really worth while letter. But the longer I wate, it would seem the farther I get from a "let up" in correspondence. So I've decided to write you briefly, at least for the present.
Of course I am not surprised that they are trying again to make trouble for you. I am sure you have been more or less expecting it. This I concluded from what has gone before.
But dear Doctor: perhaps the dear Lord is expecting something that you are not regarding. As time goes on I am convinced that we poor mortals are quite alike in many ways. For example, we are naturally inclined to minimize the importance of the spiritual and the eternal and to over-rate the physical and the temporal - the latter at the cost of the former. Hence the Good God, often in His mercy, sends something - at least permits it - to come to us for the purpose of waking us up, lest we forget the final purpose of our exist- ence as rational creatures, viz. to know our CREATOR and, in love and service to blend our existence with His for all eternity.
